svg.title: Map Each Step to a Foundry Tool
svg.desc: A process broken into steps, each mapped to a Foundry Tool: read a photo with Azure Vision, extract form fields with Document Intelligence, find relevant records with Azure AI Search, transcribe calls with Speech, and generate the answer with a Foundry model.
svg.text: Map Each Step to a Foundry Tool
Most custom AI processes are a chain of prebuilt capabilities.
